title: Drywall Calculator
cardBlurb: Sheets, mud, tape, and screws for walls and ceiling
metaDescription: Estimate 4x8, 4x10, or 4x12 drywall sheets, joint compound, tape, and screws for a room's walls and ceiling, with screws based on IRC fastener spacing.
secondaryKeywords: how many sheets of drywall do i need
how much drywall mud per sheet
how many drywall screws per 4x8 sheet
how much drywall tape per sheet
intent: Estimate drywall sheets, joint compound, tape, and screws for a room's walls and ceiling.
registerRow: Keyword Register: drywall calculator (Volume 2, Competition ease 2, Ad value 3, Fit 5, Priority 12); launch order 14
intro: Enter a room's size to get drywall sheets for the walls and ceiling, plus joint compound, tape, and screws. Screw counts follow the IRC fastener spacing for your framing.
chartTitle: Sheets to buy, walls vs ceiling
diagramCaption: Room with the wall and ceiling board areas. It redraws as you type.
uniqueAddition: Screw count derived from the IRC gypsum fastener spacing by surface (walls vs ceiling) and framing spacing, shown per sheet, instead of a flat screws-per-sheet number; plus a table for common room sizes.

inputs.name: openings
inputs.label: Doors and windows
inputs.help: Total area left open, 0 to 2,000 sq ft. A standard door is about 20 sq ft.

inputs.name: framing
inputs.label: Framing spacing
inputs.help: Sets how far apart the screws go (see the IRC check below the results).

inputs.name: waste
inputs.label: Waste allowance
inputs.help: 0 to 30%. Extra for cut-offs and breakage. 10% is our estimate; we found no manufacturer figure.

outputs.name: boardArea
outputs.label: Board area for mud and tape
